Use this checklist when adopting or replacing a tool in an industry / enterprise context.

## 1. Problem fit

- [ ] Problem statement is clear and measurable
- [ ] Existing tools cannot meet the need without undue cost
- [ ] Success criteria defined (time, risk, quality, cost)

## 2. Technical fit

- [ ] Integrates with current stack and identity provider
- [ ] Supports required environments (dev / test / prod)
- [ ] Meets performance and scale expectations
- [ ] Has acceptable operational model (SaaS / self-hosted / hybrid)

## 3. Security and compliance

- [ ] AuthN/AuthZ model reviewed (SSO, RBAC, audit logs)
- [ ] Data residency and retention understood
- [ ] Secrets handling is acceptable
- [ ] Vendor security posture reviewed (SOC2/ISO summaries as applicable)

## 4. Enterprise readiness

- [ ] Support model and SLA documented
- [ ] Licensing / procurement path clear
- [ ] Exit strategy / data export possible
- [ ] Training and ownership assigned

## 5. Delivery impact

- [ ] Migration or rollout plan drafted
- [ ] Observability and failure modes understood
- [ ] Cost model estimated for 12 months
- [ ] Decision recorded (prefer ADR template)
